title: Chance-Vought circular-wing "Flying Pancake" aircraft in flight over coastline
description: Air-to-air photograph of a Chance-Vought low-aspect-ratio circular-wing aircraft with two large propellers, extended landing gear, twin tail fins and US star insignia, flying above a coastline. Photo number "32964 A.C." at lower right; stamped CONFIDENTIAL in the margin. Accompanies the report's section on the Chance-Vought XF5U-1.
